meta.title: Network partition & heal — an echo chamber forms, then gets corrected
meta.description: 10 nodes split into two islands with no path between them. Island A has real sources and converges to the truth on its own. Island B has no real sources at all — only a single byzantine seed — so with no honest signal reachable inside its own island, it echo-chambers onto the false claim. At round 12 a few bridge edges reconnect the islands and Island A's belief propagates in and corrects Island B.
